svg.title: macOS · Shape-mation · builder · Sequence board · Fixed shape · 900×720 sheet in a 960×800 window
svg.desc: Mirrors App/Shapemation/ShapemationBoardView.swift — the Sequence board, the step between Mode and Timing under the frame modes (code first 2026-09-20/21, Steven's call; the prototype docs/shapemation/prototype/ and the review docs/shapemation/prototype-review.md say what differs). The sheet grows to 900×720 on this step (ShapemationHomeView toggles the frame on onBoard) and sits centred in the window; drawn here in a 960×800 window. Geometry from the Debug build's accessibility dump on the tram clone (-storage.libraryRootPath …/tram-root, LL_SHAPEMATION=board LL_CHIPS=tram, 2026-09-21 morning, light appearance): nav 47.5 pt with the back circle and 'Sequence board'; the header — the option seat Least crop · Fixed shape (193×24 segmented), the Sort menu ('Sort · ' secondary + 'Smallest first' accent, a borderless Menu whose label is ONE concatenated Text), the size pop-up '1 920' with '1 440×1 920'; the rect chips 28 pt (Source · 3:4 lit, 1:1 · 4:5 · 3:2 · 16:9 · 2:3 · 9:16) each with the mean loss under it in 10 pt tertiary (L 16 % · 32 · 18 · 53 · 60 · 20 · 32); the toggles Auto-reject (on) · Show rejected (off), the count line and, at the right, the LL.ink numbers pill (jump 1.72 · mean crop 15 % · mean loss 16 %, values amber). The preview (223.5×297.5, the selected photo's output window, title chip 'Photo 13. 9. at 13:11', badge 'crop 17 %') over the strip: LL.ink, 51×68 tiles 3 pt apart (index badge, verdict dot — amber flagged, green fine — the shape box in amber, the selected tile's accent ring) hosted by MacHorizontalScroller, an NSScrollView with a LEGACY horizontal scroller always shown so a mouse can drag it and its wheel scrolls it (Steven, 2026-09-21); the note '62 in the strip · widths follow the hold · tap to select, hover to peek · 0 keys'. The 280-pt side column scrolls its cards (a legacy vertical scroller too): the source card (the source dimmed, the output window bright with a white edge, the shape in amber; 'the source; the output window over it is what stays'; the grid shape · natural · crop · margins in 12 pt tabular; Reject · Add key here · Hold · as timed), the charts card (Shape position: the natural places' x and y dots, the smoothed path solid for x and dashed for y, end handles; Shape share: as rendered, dips red; '26 dips in the size curve — the crop's zoom, or a hand order, did this') and the cog card 'Path and tolerance'. Pinned bar: Next · timing (150.5×47). Photos are flat stand-ins, never pictures. THIS FILE: the option seat on Fixed shape (pressed by AX on 2026-09-21 — LL_BOARD=fixed only scrolls the column): the toggles disabled, no numbers pill, the count line '83 members · 67 won't fill the frame · 0 upscaled past ×2', the preview as the framed output ('fits' in green), 83 tiles, the source card's window as the frame's footprint with shape · natural · placement ('scale ×1.20 · short L 0 T 0 R 0 B 0 px') and Hold, then the Fixed shape card: Shape size (Start 25 % of the height · End 25 % · Same, steppers), Shape place (two 3×3 pickers, Start / End · Same), Ease Linear · Ease in and out, '67 photos won't fill the frame'. The preview drew the photo's bottom corner until 2026-09-21: ShapemationBoardTileImage's stack grew to the footprint and the fixed frame centred it; the frame is now aligned topLeading.
